newsitem.title: INDIA: Most Indian exchanges closed on Wednesday, Friday.
newsitem.headline: Most Indian exchanges closed on Wednesday, Friday.

text.p: All major Indian stock exchanges are open this week only on Tuesday and Thursday because of a spate of holidays.
The Bombay, National, Calcutta and Delhi stock markets are closed on Wednesday for a Hindu festival and on Friday for a Moslem holiday.
The Madras and Over-the-Counter exchanges will, however, stay open on all days, but that may be subject to change.
Markets across India were closed on Monday for a national holiday.
